identification: Three framed copper relief reproductions by Creative Copper Art (27 Grose Street, Camperdown NSW), each signed 'Southgate' in the relief, limited edition of 199 with certificates: 'Hotel Tingha NSW' (edition 148/199, horizontal), 'Boys in Paddington' (182/199) and 'Man from Balmain' (178/199). Dark timber frames. Retro Australian souvenir wall art, late 20th century.
